name: Himedo (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Himedo town emblem in white: a stylised angular device of a winged top above a ring.
history: Flag of the former town of Himedo in Kumamoto Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-03-31. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1975.

features.role: Himedo town emblem — a stylised angular device of a winged top above a ring
